root_idea.summary: The root centers on separating one thing from another, whether by cutting it off, making it independent, or decisively severing a connection.
root_idea.development: From physical separation it develops meanings of independence or isolation, irrevocable finality, and exclusive devotional withdrawal. The Quranic devotional use presents separation from worldly preoccupations as wholehearted dedication to God.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic imperative is normalized to the Form V perfect citation form تَبَتَّلَ.
The inflected Quranic form تَبْتِيلًا is normalized to the verbal-noun citation form تَبْتِيلٌ.

senses.definition: To detach oneself from worldly preoccupations and devote oneself exclusively to God with sincere intention.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction تَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ, it denotes wholehearted devotional withdrawal and dedication.

senses.definition: Exclusive devotional withdrawal and sincere dedication to God.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic expression تَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا to express the act or state of devoting oneself wholly to God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut off, sever, or separate one thing from another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Basic transitive usage; بَتْلٌ and تَبْتِيلٌ are given as verbal nouns in this branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make an ʿumrah, or an ʿumrā endowment, binding independently.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized ritual or endowment construction in which the act is made obligatory by itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become broad between the shoulders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become alone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical Form V use distinct from the Quranic devotional construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To withdraw from women or abstain from sexual intercourse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical use associated with separation from marriage or sexual relations; it is distinct from the Quranic construction of exclusive devotion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman, to adorn and beautify herself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage explicitly applied to a woman.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become cut off or severed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive Form VII usage, including the separation of a palm shoot from its mother tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To exert oneself and make much progress in travelling or pacing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of strenuous progress in journeying.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gift or act made irrevocable or decisively severed; a gift after which no like gift is given, an alms cut off from its giver or property for God's cause, and, by extension, a decisive divorce or oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Appears in fixed expressions for irrevocable gifts, devoted alms, separating divorce, and a decisive oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Truth or what is true; truly or in truth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used adverbially in بَتْلًا.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm shoot or offset cut off from its mother tree and independent of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage for the detached, independent shoot.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A virgin or a woman detached from men, husbands, or worldly things; hence, a woman devoted to God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With the definite article it may be used as an epithet for Mary and for Fatimah; the devotional sense is a classical epithet usage, not the Quranic Form V verb sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slender.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to a waist.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A tree having pendulous racemes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A watercourse in the lower part of a valley.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is بُتُلٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A limb or member with its flesh, separated from the other members or standing by itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is بَتَائِلُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The posteriors.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage explained by their being distinct from the back.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An irrevocable determination or resolution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression مَرَّ عَلَى بَتِيلَةٍ مِنْ رَأْيِهِ and its variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of an ʿumrah, not conjoined with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized adjective for an independently performed minor pilgrimage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broad between the shoulders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A palm tree having a shoot or offset cut off from it and independent of it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form may also be used collectively or as a plural for such palms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Solitary or isolated.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use recorded independently of the palm-tree description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having pendulous racemes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A botanical adjectival use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Beautiful, elegant, or perfectly proportioned, with each part distinct and well formed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a woman and also to a camel; the source specifically excludes its use as an epithet for a man.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cut off or severed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-result adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Irrevocable, of a determination or resolution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a decision that has been decisively fixed.

cautions: The Quranic Form V construction تَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ is represented with the devotional meaning explicitly supported for 73:8. The abstention-from-marriage meaning is retained as a broader Classical Arabic use rather than assigned to that Quranic occurrence.
